notes.title: Four new levels are available!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31487951/062a68e6fc75ad1aa323f41ac7b3184b6a0912ce.png[/img]

Four new levels (with a new biome) are already available! You can start them after the 12th level.

We also made some changes to the old locations.
